summary: Evergy Kansas Central, Inc., a Kansas electric utility subsidiary of Evergy, Inc., filed a combined Form 8-K reporting the issuance of $350,000,000 aggregate principal amount of First Mortgage Bonds, 5.600% Series due 2034. The bonds were sold under a September 10, 2026 underwriting agreement with PNC Capital Markets, RBC Capital Markets, Truist Securities and U.S. Bancorp Investments as representatives, registered on a Form S-3 shelf. Proceeds fund ordinary utility operations and refinancing; the Fifty-Sixth Supplemental Indenture with Bank of New York Mellon as trustee provides first-mortgage collateral. Routine debt capital markets activity; no special-situation or deal terms apply.
